summary.key_theme: IBM 透過與 Arm 的策略性合作與混合雲業務的強勁成長，成功推動市場對其技術轉型與長期獲利能力的信心。

bullish.title: IBM Unveils First Dual‑Architecture Mainframe Processor To Support IBM And Arm Platforms In Future IBM Z And LinuxONE Systems
bullish.reason: IBM 推出首款雙架構大型主機處理器，整合 Arm 架構，此舉將顯著擴大 IBM Z 與 LinuxONE 系統的軟體生態系，提升競爭優勢。

bullish.title: Why Is Arm Holdings (ARM) Stock Trending After Hours — Arm Holdings shares climbed 4.76% in after-hours trading Wednesday, extending gains after an expanded IBM collaboration
bullish.reason: 市場對 IBM 與 Arm 的合作反應正面，顯示投資人認可該合作對雙方技術互補與市場擴張的潛在價值。

bullish.title: IBM: Big Blue Is Not Going Back To The Dinosaur Age — Hybrid Cloud and Data segments delivered double-digit growth
bullish.reason: 分析指出 IBM 在混合雲與數據業務實現雙位數成長，證明公司轉型策略成功，擺脫傳統業務衰退的刻板印象。

bullish.title: Why Is IBM (IBM) Up 13.1% Since Last Earnings Report?
bullish.reason: IBM 自上季財報公布後股價上漲 13.1 %，反映市場對其獲利能力與未來成長預期的重新定價。

bullish.title: TD SYNNEX (SNX) Expands IBM Footprint, Is It Still A Bargain?
bullish.reason: 通路夥伴 TD SYNNEX 擴大 IBM 產品的經銷版圖，有助於提升 IBM 軟硬體產品在企業市場的滲透率。

neutral.title: Jim Cramer: Williams Companies Is 'Terrific,' This Tech Company Had An ‘Amazing’ Quarter
neutral.reason: 財經評論員 Jim Cramer 給予 IBM 正面評價，雖具備正面情緒，但屬於市場觀點分享，對股價實質影響有限。

neutral.title: Circle Internet shares surge after acquisition of IBM blockchain patent portfolio
neutral.reason: IBM 出售區塊鏈專利組合予 Circle Internet，此為資產活化行為，對 IBM 本身核心業務影響中性。
